title: Oxbridge & medicine: UCAS deadline 15 October 2026
caption: Applying to Oxford, Cambridge, medicine, dentistry or vet for 2027? UCAS closes 15 Oct at 6pm UK time. Check your school's internal deadline TODAY. Good luck 🍀

slides.headline: Oxbridge & medicine: UCAS closes {15 Oct, 6pm}
slides.sub: That's 7 days from today. Your final checklist.

slides.headline: Who it's {for}
slides.body: Any Oxford or Cambridge course, plus most medicine, dentistry and vet courses, for 2027 entry.

slides.headline: Your school's deadline is {earlier}
slides.body: They need time to add your reference and predicted grades. Check the internal date today.

slides.headline: of Oxford admits had {A*AA or better}
slides.body: Grades still matter after you apply. Keep revising.

slides.headline: Not Oxbridge or medicine?
slides.body: Most other courses close {13 January 2027, 6pm}. Check each course's deadline on UCAS.

slides.headline: Predicted grades {to hit?}
slides.body: Pick your three A-levels and practise real past papers, marked instantly.

sources.title: 2027 entry deadline for the universities of Oxford and Cambridge and most courses in medicine
sources.claim: Applications for 2027 entry to Oxford, Cambridge and most medicine, veterinary medicine/science and dentistry courses must reach UCAS by 18:00 UK time on 15 October 2026. Most other courses: 18:00 on 13 January 2027.

sources.title: When Is The UCAS Application Deadline? Preparing Students For 2027 Entry
sources.claim: Schools set earlier internal deadlines; the school must check the application, attach the reference and predicted grades, and send it before 18:00.

sources.title: Undergraduate Admissions Report 2026 (Table 1.1)
sources.claim: 2025 cycle: 23,329 applications, 3,891 offers, 3,302 admitted (offer rate 16.7%). 87.2% of admitted students were awarded A*AA or better at A-level.

sources.title: Plasmo app screens (subject picker, mock exams, question view), captured Oct 2026
sources.claim: In-app copy: 'Answer, tap Mark, get your mark and feedback instantly'; 'Mark your first answer to unlock your predicted grade. It sharpens with every answer.'; mock exams by board (AQA, Edexcel, OCR); next-exam countdown; A-level subject picker.
